title: Summer Nocturne
identity: Sherwood Shaffer’s Summer Nocturne is an alto saxophone and piano work in Dorn DORN1405. Andrew Paul Hays’s 2007 DMA dissertation at the University of North Carolina at Greensboro identifies it as a five-movement continuous work written for Jonathan Helton during his undergraduate study at North Carolina School of the Arts.

evidence.claim: Retailer page identifies DORN1405 and score/part details.

The indexed page 44 passage discusses subtle meter changes tied to melodic phrasing and cites Summer Nocturne, mm. 159–162, Example 10b. The original University of North Carolina at Greensboro dissertation repository record is linked separately; its PDF link returned 403, so this text remains search-index evidence.

review_focus: The performer guide flags subtle changes of meter tied to melodic phrasing as an execution challenge in Shaffer’s saxophone writing; its measure-specific Summer Nocturne example makes meter and pulse continuity a useful score-review focus.
collection_flag: The dissertation documents the work’s student commission context for Jonathan Helton at NCSA; this provenance does not establish a teaching grade.
